title: Infrastructure Weekly Update — 2026-06-29
body:
TL;DR:
- Fleet operating with ~72% avg GPU utilization across active pools; peak windows hit 88% in US-WEST during ML training bursts.
- Minor regional capacity shortfall on 2026-06-26 (US-WEST) due to scheduled data center power maintenance — automated failover worked but added ~150ms tail latency for affected requests.
- Q3 demand forecasted +25% driven by 2 large customers (onboarding and evals). Recommend committing additional reserved capacity (see Capacity planning).

Metrics (last 7 days):
- Avg GPU utilization (all pools): 72%
- P95 latency (chat endpoints, hosted): 260ms
- Preemptible (spot) reclaim rate: 4.6% (down from 6.1% after scheduler tuning)
- NVMe cache hit rate (KV/prefix caching): 84%
- Cost per 1M tokens (estimated, hosted): down ~15% after batching + quantization pilot

Incidents / Notable events:
- 2026-06-26 03:40 UTC — Data center maintenance in us-west-2 caused ~45m of partial GPU host unavailability (retired hosts for PSU swap). Impact: ~12% capacity loss in us-west-2 for 45m.
  - Mitigation: Smart routing (regional fallback -> us-east-1 + dedicated reserved pool) kept service up, but some requests experienced increased tail latency; post-mortem scheduled.
  - Action: Add a pre-maintenance capacity check and automated pre-warm of dedicated pools (INFRA-432). Owner: Miguel. Due: 2026-07-06.

Capacity & provisioning:
- Current committed reserved capacity: 1,120 A100-equivalent GPUs across Dedicated pools.
- Hot pools (low-latency): 420 GPUs (us-east-1 + eu-west-1).
- Cold/batch pools (preemptible-friendly): 700 GPUs.
- Incoming procurement: 120x H100 nodes (estimated +480 A100-equivalent) ETA mid-July (PO-2026-07-01). Procurement team confirmed shipping schedule.
- Short-term gap: projected 300 A100-equivalent shortage during high-traffic weekdays in early July if two onboarding customers ramp to prod as expected. Recommendation: 1) accelerate soft-commit for 200 reserved GPUs (use quarterly reserved tranche), 2) increase spot fallback pool by 150 GPUs and raise preemptible eviction tolerance for batch workloads.

Region updates:
- us-west-2: degraded capacity 06/26 during maintenance; otherwise healthy. Working with DC ops for maintenance window alignment to lower-traffic windows.
- us-east-1: high utilization during training windows but headroom exists for short failovers.
- eu-west-1: stable; provisioning automation verified for new H100 nodes.
- ap-southeast-1: low utilization but adding low-latency pool for APAC pilot customers in Aug.

Performance & optimization:
- Quantization pilot across 3 production models is live; initial numbers show ~12-18% GPU-memory savings and ~10-15% cost per token reduction with negligible quality regressions on our eval suites.
- Continuous batching improvements reduced per-token CPU overhead; rollout to hosted API expected next week.
- KV/prefix cache tuning gave a +6% effective throughput improvement for multi-turn chat workloads.

Planned maintenance / upgrades:
- 2026-07-10 — Rolling kernel + container runtime upgrade across Dedicated hot pools (expected 2-3% perf variance; will enable improved NVLink handling). Maintenance will be staged by region; teams will watch P95 latency and autoscale triggers.
- 2026-07-18 — Add H100 nodes to eu-west-1; automation already validated in staging.

Risk & blockers:
- Procurement lag risk: if H100 shipment slips >2 weeks we will not meet the expected capacity required for Q3 onboarding. Contingency: temporarily convert up to 200 A100 reserved units to spot-optimized instances to keep throughput but accept higher variability.
- SRE bandwidth: multiple post-mortems and upgrade windows overlap with product launches (GTM). Need to prioritize tasks and possibly engage solutions-eng for runbook automation.

Action items (owner — due):
- Miguel Torres — Implement automated pre-warm for dedicated pools before scheduled DC maintenance (INFRA-432) — 2026-07-06.
- Liu Chen — Finalize H100 rollout playbook and test rollback on staging — 2026-07-08.
- Noah Green — Increase spot pool capacity + update scheduler eviction tolerance for batch jobs — 2026-07-03.
- Asha Patel — Draft reservation recommendation and cost impact for Q3 (commit vs flex) — 2026-07-02.
- SRE (rotation) — Post-mortem for 2026-06-26 outage; include lessons and runbook updates — 2026-07-05.

Notes / open questions:
- Need confirmation from Sales on exact ramp profiles for the two large customers (expected start dates: early July and mid-August). Sales asked for capacity guarantees; product requires SLOs.
- Consider a short-term promotional reserved tranche for early-adopter customers to offload bursty load from hosted pools. Finance wants projected ROI before any commitment.

Appendix (short):
- Relevant tickets: INFRA-432 (pre-warm automation), INFRA-447 (H100 rollout), INFRA-458 (spot scheduler tuning).
- Quick numbers snapshot: total GPUs online 1,220 (incl. newly provisioned H100 arrival slots), avg utilization 72%, 7-day incidents: 1 minor capacity event.

If you want a condensed 1-slide summary for execs, I can produce one with the ask (reserved commitment + contingency plan) and estimated monthly cost delta.

— Asha
